title: The Case of the Missing Treasure
tagline: The treasure box vanished from Detective Headquarters. Crack the case!

checklist: Print and cut the clue cards
Hide the treasure (a box of prizes, treats or party favors) under a table
Hide Clue #2 through #10 using the hiding spot guide
Put the Case Closed card with the treasure
Keep Clue #1 in your hand to start

intro.speaker: ivy
lines: The treasure box has vanished from Detective Headquarters, and {name} has been chosen to lead the investigation.
Whoever took it left a trail of clues all over this house.
Grab your magnifying glass. Look closely. A good detective notices everything!

steps.speaker: ivy
steps.riddle: Detectives, the case has begun! Look where cold snacks hide from the sun.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.riddle: Every good detective keeps clean. Check by the sink where the soap is seen.
steps.hint: Where do you wash your hands?

steps.speaker: ivy
steps.riddle: This clue is soft and comfy too. Search the couch, it's hiding from you!

steps.speaker: theo
steps.riddle: Detectives read to learn the facts. Look where the books stand in their stacks.

steps.speaker: ivy
steps.riddle: Every suspect leaves a track. Check the shoes, then hurry back!
steps.hint: Look where the shoes are kept.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.riddle: Even detectives need a rest. Look where pillows do their best.
steps.hint: Check a bed or under a pillow.

steps.speaker: ivy
steps.riddle: A clue is hiding with the toys. Search with care and not much noise!

steps.speaker: theo
steps.riddle: Round and round the clothes all go. Check the washer, high or low.

steps.speaker: ivy
steps.riddle: Coats and jackets hang in a line. Check the closet, the clue is fine!

steps.speaker: theo
steps.riddle: Super sleuths, you've cracked the case! Crawl down low where the chairs all meet. The treasure waits beneath your feet!
steps.spot: Under the kitchen or dining table

found: Another clue for the case file!

finale.title: Case Closed!
lines: Outstanding detective work, {name}. Headquarters is proud of you!

print.subtitle: A printable detective mystery where kids follow clues to find the missing treasure.
coverFeatures: Quest Master on your phone: reads the clues, gives hints, throws the confetti
Blank cards for your own hiding spots
storyLines: This morning, the treasure box vanished from Detective Headquarters.
No one saw who took it. But whoever it was left a trail of clues all over this house.
Your mission: follow every clue, search every corner, and bring the treasure home.
Look high. Look low. Notice everything. That's what detectives do.
Your first clue is in your hands...
print.storyCall: The case is open. Good luck, detectives!

storyAside.speaker: theo
storyAside.text: Keep your eyes sharp. Clues love to hide in plain sight!

startCard.speaker: ivy
startCard.title: Case Open!
startCard.text: Detectives, the treasure is missing! Follow the clues, look closely, and crack the case!

print.parentTip: Hand out flashlights, even in daylight. Every detective feels more official with one.

tips.title: Detective gear station
tips.text: Let detectives suit up while everyone arrives.
list: Paper badges with their detective name
Small notebooks for writing down clues
Sunglasses or paper mustaches for disguises

tips.title: Set the scene
list: Tape yellow streamers across doorways like crime scene tape
Play mystery music while they search
Give the lead detective a title, like Chief Inspector

tips.title: Detective snacks
tips.text: Save these for after the case is closed.
list: Fingerprint cookies: thumbprint cookies with jam
Clue mix: popcorn, pretzels and candy
Secret agent juice: any drink with a fun straw

tips.title: Close the case
tips.text: When the last clue leads to the treasure, everyone shouts "Case closed!" Then open the treasure together and hand out Junior Detective certificates.

certificate.title: Official Junior Detective
certificate.body: for cracking the Case of the Missing Treasure with sharp eyes and clever thinking.

print.backLine: If your detectives loved this case, more mysteries are on the way.
